# 🩸 LINDA · Project Luteal
The second she starts lutealing, Linda lines up flowers, comfort food and movie options, and clears your Friday night.

**Five lanes, one import.** Every lane starts with the same ⚙️ Settings node. Fill those in, connect Telegram, Gmail, Google Calendar, Apify and Anthropic, then activate.

Built by Mycelium AI · @aaronautomates

## 1 · Her cycle
She logs her period in **Apple Health** (Flo stopped writing to it in 2023). An iPhone Shortcut runs when she plugs her phone in: *Find Health Samples → Menstrual Flow*, then *Get Contents of URL* POSTs `{last_period_start, avg_cycle_days, secret}` here.

parameters.text:
⚠️ Caution: Shark week incoming. Show up.

– Linda

parameters.content:
## 2 · The morning
Your **Telegram bot** sends both messages: hers, and the warning to you. She messages the bot once to start the chat, so her reply comes straight back into lane 3. Free, no SMS credits. (Swap the Telegram nodes for Twilio if you'd rather it came as a text.)

parameters.text:
=💐 {{ $('⚙️ Settings · reply').first().json.flowers.order }} ordered from {{ $('Write the order').first().json.florist }}. Landing before {{ $('⚙️ Settings · reply').first().json.flowers.deliver_by }}.

📅 Boys' night moved to next Friday. You're on duty. No excuses.

– Linda

parameters.content:
## 3 · She replies → flowers + Friday
Her reply to the bot lands on this Telegram trigger. **OpenStreetMap** (Nominatim) finds the closest florist to her work (free, no key). The order is emailed to the shop. Ring them once first and leave a card on file, so *charge my card* is true. Then Google Calendar moves anything called "boys" this Friday a week out (the invite update emails them) and blocks the night.

parameters.text:
=🍔 Grill'd ordered. Mustard & Pickled + sweet potato chips, driver booked to hers.

– Linda

parameters.content:
## 4 · 5:30pm comfort order
**Uber Eats has no ordering API** (it's merchant-side only). So: a headless browser (**Browserless**) reorders her Grill'd favourite as a pickup, then **Uber Direct**, Uber's real courier API, sends a driver from Grill'd to her door. Uber Direct's sandbox has a robot courier for testing.

options.systemMessage: You are Linda, an agent who looks after his girlfriend while she's in her luteal phase. Tonight she is tired, a bit crampy and does not want to think. From the list you are given, pick exactly three films: COMFORT (warm, feel-good, romance, uplifting), FUNNY (actually funny, light) and BRAIN_OFF (easy, fun, zero effort). Never horror, nothing grim, nothing violent or bleak, and nothing about grief, death, illness or loss. Use what you know about each film, not just its genre tags. Only pick titles that appear in the list. 'title' is the film's name exactly as listed, with no year. 'why' is at most 7 words and a bit cheeky.

parameters.content:
## 5 · Driver's on the way → movies
Uber Direct posts every status to this webhook; **pickup_complete / dropoff** is the moment the driver leaves with the food. **Apify** scrapes what's trending on Netflix AU from JustWatch, her Netflix *Viewing activity* CSV (Netflix has no API) knocks out what she's seen, and **Linda** (Claude) picks one comfort, one funny, one brain-off.
